summary: Machine identity/tradability, required automated source freshness, Beast integrity, evidence queue, persistence and exact-head dispatched CI are healthy for the reviewed cycle, but FINRA remains freshness-only without row-level event data and Google Sheet parity has not yet been independently verified by this lane. The cycle must therefore remain non-qualifying until Chief completes the human-mirror check and required OTC/event interpretation.
